45 weeks = 45 × 7 = 315 days.  
Add 5 days → total extra days = 320 days.  
Start: 1114-02-06 (assuming format is DD-MM-YYYY, so 6 Feb 1114).  
Add 320 days:  
1114 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400? 1114 mod 4 = 2, so not leap).  
Days in Feb 1114 = 28, so from Feb 6: 28 - 6 = 22 days left in Feb.  
Remaining days after Feb: 320 - 22 = 298.  
March (31) → 298 - 31 = 267.  
April (30) → 267 - 30 = 237.  
May (31) → 237 - 31 = 206.  
June (30) → 206 - 30 = 176.  
July (31) → 176 - 31 = 145.  
August (31) → 145 - 31 = 114.  
September (30) → 114 - 30 = 84.  
October (31) → 84 - 31 = 53.  
November (30) → 53 - 30 = 23.  
December has 31 days, so 23 days into December is Dec 24.  
Year remains 1114.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1114-12-24
